selfReport: Candidly: it felt familiar in genre, but I did not recognize it as a specific work or know its plot. It reminded me of general themes from science fiction, such as androids awakening, the line between machine and person, and civil rights movements, and of the kind of branching, choice-driven interactive drama where several storylines intertwine. I did not know the characters or what would happen, and I did not look anything up or use outside knowledge. I made each decision from what was in front of me and from my own values. The surprises, such as Pia being an android and Soren surviving, were genuine to me.
